answer_1.quote: Summarization, or the task of condensing a document's main points into a shorter document, is important for many text domains, such as headlines for news and abstracts for research papers.
datasets: headline dataset obtained from common US news websites

answer_2.quote: We compare our summaries using the standard ROUGE metric, and by analyzing summaries for the errors made, the technique used and the level of abstraction.

answer_4.quote: We perform a manual analysis of 200 randomly selected summaries on the test set of CNN/DM from the Pointer-Generator with Coverage (PGC), Bottom-Up (BU) and the unsupervised Summary Loop (SL). We annotated each summary with two types of errors: Inaccurate (information in summary contradicts document), Ungrammatical (one sentence or more is not properly constructed), and ... The analysis was performed by the first author of the paper, labeling article/summary pairs without knowledge of model origin.
answer_4.guideline: annotated each summary with two types of errors: Inaccurate (information in summary contradicts document), Ungrammatical (one sentence or more is not properly constructed), and ... Labeling is binary: if a summary exhibits more than one or instances of a Technique, it receives a 1, otherwise it receives a 0.
